title: B2B market research for buying committees: a role-based framework
summary: B2B market research fails when one respondent stands in for a six-person buying group. Capture role-specific priorities and consensus that predict deals.
body_markdown:
What is AI-moderated qualitative research, and how is it different from a survey? +


AI-moderated qualitative research uses an AI research assistant to conduct adaptive video interviews, probing based on what each person says rather than following a fixed script. A survey presents the same static questions to everyone and captures responses in isolation. AI-moderated research outputs verbatim quotes, video clips, and thematic synthesis tied to real people, so every finding can be traced back to who said it.


How long does B2B market research take with an AI research assistant instead of a traditional agency? +


The timeline depends on study complexity and recruitment. Traditional B2B research runs for weeks or months, covering recruitment, scheduling, moderation, transcription, analysis, and reporting, often long enough that the buying decision has moved on by the time findings land. An AI research assistant compresses the middle: interviews run asynchronously, and analysis begins as each conversation closes, so findings are more likely to arrive while the decision is still open.


Are participants more open with an AI research assistant than with a human? +


Many participants are more candid without a researcher in the room. People are less inclined to shape answers to please an interviewer and more willing to voice criticism or uncertainty, which matters most in B2B contexts covering purchasing decisions, supplier evaluations, and brand perceptions.


How do you make AI-moderated findings credible enough for senior stakeholders? +


Credibility rests on the moderation methodology, the traceability of every finding, and the researchers who designed the study. Every insight should trace back to a real participant who said it, supported by verbatim quotes and video rather than an unsourced summary. Study design still requires experienced researchers to frame hypotheses and interpret findings in a business context.


Can AI-moderated interviews run across multiple languages and markets at once? +


Yes. Moderation operates across 50+ languages, so a single study can run simultaneously in markets that would otherwise require separate agency engagements, local moderators, and sequential fieldwork under a traditional model.
